

```{r}
install.packages("rpart")
install.packages("rpart.plot")
```

Load Packages
```{r}
library(sf) # vector data
library(terra) # raster data
library(here) # file path management
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart) # recursive partitioning and regression trees
library(rpart.plot) # plotting for rpart
library(tmap) # map making
library(stars)
library(kableExtra)
```

Create Night Light Change raster
```{r}
NightLights2021_02_07_Tile5 <- read_stars(here("data","VNP46A1","VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif"))

NightLights2021_02_07_Tile6 <- read_stars(here("data","VNP46A1","VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif"))

NightLights2021_02_16_Tile5 <- read_stars(here("data","VNP46A1","VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif"))

NightLights2021_02_16_Tile6 <- read_stars(here("data","VNP46A1","VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif"))

NightLights2021_02_07 <- st_mosaic(NightLights2021_02_07_Tile5, NightLights2021_02_07_Tile6)

NightLights2021_02_16 <- st_mosaic(NightLights2021_02_16_Tile5, NightLights2021_02_16_Tile6)
```

Boundingbox wrangling for 02_16 and 02_07

```{r}
#Create bounding box
bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5), crs = st_crs(NightLights2021_02_16))

#Crop pre and post storm
lights_07 <- st_crop(NightLights2021_02_07, bbox)
lights_16 <- st_crop(NightLights2021_02_16, bbox)

#Mask layers that are not 0-1000 as NA
masked_houston_07 <- lights_07
masked_houston_07[(masked_houston_07 > 1000) | (masked_houston_07 <= 0)] <- NA

masked_houston_16 <- lights_16
masked_houston_16[(masked_houston_16 > 1000) | (masked_houston_16 <= 0)] <- NA

# Combine pre and post storm layers
combined_mask <- c(masked_houston_07, masked_houston_16)

# Rename layers
names(combined_mask) <- c(
  "February 7, 2021", "February 16, 2021"
)
```

Map of light intensities
```{r}
# Map the combined raster to show lights pre and post storm
tm_shape(combined_mask)+
  tm_raster(
    col.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Light Intensity (nW cm^2 sr^1)",
      orientation = "landscape",
      title.size = 0.8,
      text.size = 0.8
    ),
    col.scale = tm_scale(values = "inferno")
  ) +
    tm_facets(ncol = 2, free.scales = FALSE) +
    tm_graticules(
      col = "white",
      lwd = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.2,
      labels.size = 0.5,
      labels.pos = c("left","bottom"),
      n.x = 4,
      n.y = 4
    ) +
      tm_layout(
        scale = 0.8,
        legend.position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom"),
        legend.frame = TRUE,
        panels.labels = c(
          "February 7, 2021 (Pre-Storm)",
          "February 16, 2021 (Post-Storm)"
        ),
        panel.label.size = 1.0
      ) +
      tm_title("Nighttime Light Intensity in Houston Pre and Post 2021 Winter Storm")
```

Reclassify night light change raster to binary
```{r}
# Find change in night lights from the 16th to the 7th
NightLightChange <- rast(NightLights2021_02_16) - rast(NightLights2021_02_07)

#Reclassification matrix using 200 threshold
reclass_matrix <- matrix(c(-Inf, 200, NA,
                              200, Inf, 1),
                              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

#Feed reclass matrix into nightlights
NightLightReclass <- classify(NightLightChange, rcl = reclass_matrix)

#Vectorize night lights
NightLightReclass <- st_as_stars(NightLightReclass)

NightLightReclass <- st_as_sf(NightLightReclass)

NightLightReclass <- st_make_valid(NightLightReclass)

#Crop lights to bounding box
houston_lights <- st_crop(NightLightReclass, bbox)

# Reproject to CRS 3083
houston_lights <- st_transform(houston_lights, crs = 'EPSG:3083')
```

Identify areas within 200m of all highways
```{r}
# Read in buildings data
buildings <- sf::st_read(here::here(
  "data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"), query = "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type IN ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')")

# Read in roads data
roads <- sf::st_read(here::here(
  "data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"), query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'")
```

Create 200m buffer around roads
```{r}
# Project roads to CRS 3083
roads <- st_transform(roads, crs = 3083)

#Create 200 m buffer around roads
roads_buffer_200m = st_union(st_buffer(roads, dist = 200))

non_hw_lights <- st_difference(houston_lights, roads_buffer_200m)
```

# Identify homes impacted by blacklouts
```{r}
# Project buildings to standard 3083 CRS
buildings <- st_transform(buildings, crs = 3083)

# Identify buildings in blackout areas
blackout_homes <- st_intersection(buildings, non_hw_lights)
```

```{r}
#Filter homes to blackout homes
homes_in_blackout <- buildings |> 
  st_filter(non_hw_lights)

#Number of homes affected by blackout
n_homes_blackout <- nrow(homes_in_blackout)
```

# Map of homes likely affected by blackouts
```{r}
#Create points for homes
all_homes <- st_centroid(buildings)
unaffected_homes <- all_homes[!all_homes$osm_id %in% blackout_homes$osm_id, ]
affected_homes <- st_centroid(blackout_homes)
```

Final Map

```{r}
tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_shape(roads) +
  tm_lines(col = "orange3", lwd = 0.8) +
  tm_shape(unaffected_homes) +
  tm_dots(fill = "green", size = 0.01, fill_alpha = 0.3) +
  tm_shape(affected_homes) +
  tm_dots(fill = "red", size = 0.01, fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_add_legend(
    type = "symbols",
    labels = c("Blackout", "No Blackout"),
    fill = c("red","green"),
    shape = 21,
    size = 0.6,
    title = "Homes"
  ) +
    tm_title("Homes likely affected by blackout from February 2021 Winter Storm (Houston)") +
    tm_legend(type = "lines", labels = "Highways", col = "orange3", lwd = 0.8) +
    tm_scalebar(position = c("right","bottom"), text.size = 0.5) +
    tm_compass(position = c("right","top"))
```

# Reflection
The map shows homes likely affected by the 2021 winter storm in Houston, Texas. In our data wrangling and analysis, the basis for experiencing a blackout was a drop of more than 200 nW cm-2sr-1, but this might exclude homes that did experience did have blackouts without meeting this threshold of a drop. Cloud cover also limits our data to just 2 days that were before and after the storm, but can not give us the days immediately before or afterwards. We are also limited by the raster resolution, and if it was higher resolution the visual representation of the homes would also be better representative.
